column1: # lint-markdown.sh: PostToolUse feedback for a Markdown file that was written.
#   exit     expected exit status: 0 for silence, 2 for feedback
#   stderr   `|` separated substrings that must appear in stderr, or `-` when
#   tool     the tool_name put in the JSON
#   cwd      directory put in the JSON, relative to the fixture root (`.` = root)
#   payload  tool_input.command for Bash, tool_input.file_path otherwise
# Fields are separated by a single TAB; `-` stands in for an empty field.
# In the payload, \n becomes a newline, \t a tab and @FX@ the fixture root.
# Fixtures: bad1.md violates MD022/MD047, bad2.md violates MD012/MD047,
# good.md is clean, old.md violates but carries an mtime from 2020, and
# .claude/plans/p1.md violates but is excluded as a plan file.
# --- a violating .md written through a heredoc reaches exit 2 ---

column5:
cat > bad1.md <<'EOF'
# Bad One
Text right after heading.
EOF
printf x >> bad1.md ; printf x >> bad2.md
